description: This is a Lua source file defining a JSX-like string builder called 'luax' with several utility functions for HTML string generation, manipulation, and formatting, including a main function 'luax' and utility modules.

methods.name: utils.is_single_closing
methods.description: Checks if an HTML element is self-closing based on the list of tags.

methods.name: utils.join
methods.description: Joins an array of strings with a separator.

methods.name: utils.map
methods.description: Maps data to strings using a callback function.

methods.name: utils.match
methods.description: Performs pattern matching for inline logic, executing functions or returning strings based on key.

methods.name: utils.split
methods.description: Splits a string into an array based on a separator.

methods.name: utils.filter
methods.description: Filters a numeric table based on a callback condition.

methods.name: utils.insert
methods.description: Inserts a segment into a string at a specified position.

methods.name: utils.format_props
methods.description: Formats a table of properties into an HTML attribute string.

methods.name: utils.children_to_string
methods.description: Converts children elements (strings, tables) into a concatenated string.

methods.name: luax
